title: Haye Ghazi Abbas
body:
karbobala ke dasht mein goonji hai ye sada
haye ghazi abbas haye ghazi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
maara gaya hai dasht mein pyasa shahe huda
haye ghazi abbas haye ghazi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
shaane kata ke sogaye darya ke kinare
bali sakina aap ko reh reh ke pukare
darya se aa ke bachi ko ab dedo dilaasa
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheeni hai uski baaliyan maare hai tamache
bali sakina roti hai do aa ke dilaase
kaisa sitam ye nanhi si bachi pe hogaya
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad tanha hai unhe aa kar ke bachalo
jalte huwe qaimon ki zara aag bujhado
aa ke sahara dijiye zainab hui tanha
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache hai tanha bibiyan ghabrayi hui hai
shaam e ghariban dekh ke tharrayi hui hai
ahle haram pe hoti hai har tarha ki jafa
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaaron se le jayenge hum ahle haram ko
sajjad bhala kaise sahe koh e sitam ko
kaise sahega zakhm ye sajjad akela
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
chayi hai ghata zulm ki har soo chale aao
zainab puakri akbare mehroo chale aao
abbas kahan hai unhe awaaz do beta
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho shakeel parchame abbas utha hai
dil thaam ke rehan ne ye nauha padha hai
mashke sakina dekh ke phat'ta hai kaleja
haye ghazi abbas...
karbobala ke dasht...
author: Shakeel Kazmi
